title: The library calendar counts days in the library's time zone
then: The default time zone is New York. A due date 14 days on crosses a year end; 23:30 on 2 March in New York, already 3 March in UTC, counts as 2 March; the same instant counts as 3 March in Auckland. An unknown time zone is refused, by the calendar and by the lending service.

title: A month's outcome measures are counted from the library's records
when: Records a month of loans, one returned late and one on a tool needing repair, and measures it; then asks for a month not written YYYY-MM.
then: Expects the loans per tool, the share late, the loans of tools needing repair and the active members, and the bad month refused.
